newsitem.title: USA: Ashland cancels Santa Fe contract.
newsitem.headline: Ashland cancels Santa Fe contract.

text.p: Santa Fe International Corp said Monday that it has received a notice of termination of a one-year drilling contract from Ashland Inc valued at $69,500 per day.

The termination notice, said the company, follows recent news that the government of Nigeria canceled Ashland's operating license. According to sources close to the negotiations, talks between Ashland and Nigeria are said to be continuing.
The contract, which was scheduled to start in October, concerns the Compact Driller, a cantilever jack-up rig currently operating off the Ivory Coast for another Santa Fe customer.

In a statement, Richard Hoffman, Santa Fe's vice-president of investor relations, said "We are presently reviewing our opportunities for other potential contracts for this rig after its current work is completed at the end of September. Until we thoroughly review these opportunities, it is impossible to determine what, if any, the economic impact will be."
Santa Fe International is an international offshore and land contract driller which owns and operates a fleet of 26 marine drilling rigs and 27 land drilling rigs.
